gizmo.title: Hlonza izindawo ezibalulekile
gizmo.description: Abafundi bathola izindawo ezifanele esithombeni ngokuchofoza, ukuthepha noma ukuhambisa isiphambano sekhibhodi. Okuhambisana nemephu yesithombe okunamamaki.

configure.title: Umbhalo ongenye indlela
configure.description: Ichaza isithombe kubantu abangakwazi ukusibona. Ayilokothi iboniswe njengesihloko.

configure.title: Isihloko
configure.description: Isihloko esifushane esibonakalayo esiboniswa ngaphezu kwesithombe.

configure.title: Umbuzo
configure.description: Lokho abafundi abacelwa ukuthi bakuthole esithombeni.

configure.title: Izimpendulo
configure.description: Impendulo ngayinye iyi-oval eqanjwe igama esithombeni. Indawo nosayizi kungamaphesenti esithombe, kulinganiswa kusuka ekhoneni laso eliphezulu kwesokunxele. Ngesikhathi sokuhlela, yonke impendulo idwetshelwa umugqa esithombeni.

advanced.title: Imizamo
advanced.description: Izikhathi umfundi angazama ngazo. U-0 usho ukuthi akunamkhawulo.

advanced.title: Amaphutha avunyelwe
advanced.description: Mangaki amaphutha aqeda umzamo. U-0 usho ukuthi akunamkhawulo, futhi abafundi bathola inkinobho ethi Qeda.

advanced.title: Iyagoqeka
advanced.description: Bonisa lo mbuzo njengomugqa ovuleka futhi uvaleke. Ukuvula owodwa kuvala eminye imibuzo egoqekayo eseduze nawo.

advanced.title: Qala kugoqiwe
advanced.description: Uma igoqeka, qala njengomugqa ovaliwe obonisa umbuzo nesimo sawo kuphela.

advanced.title: Ifomethi yokumaka
advanced.description: OER Schema: ifomethi yokumaka yalokhu kuhlola (isb. amaphuzu, uhlamvu, amaphesenti, ukuqedwa).

advanced.title: Inhloso yokufunda
advanced.description: OER Schema: inhloso yokufunda ehlobene nalokhu kuhlola.

developer.title: Igama lequizi
developer.description: Igama lequizi elidluliselwe ukuze lisetshenziswe ezindaweni eziqhutshwa yi-xAPI ukuze kuhlonzwe le nto

developer.title: Isifundo
developer.description: OER Schema: isifundo lokhu kuhlola okuhloselwe sona.
